page_title: Novel Drug Approvals for 2015 (CDER companion table to Novel Drugs Summary 2015)

rows_to_add.indication: To treat patients with a rare disease known as lysosomal acid lipase (LAL) deficiency.
To treat patients with hereditary orotic aciduria.
To treat pediatric and adult patients with bile acid synthesis disorders due to single enzyme defects, and for patients with peroxisomal disorders.

To treat adults with complicated intra-abdominal infections (cIAI), in combination with metronidazole, and complicated urinary tract infections (cUTI), including kidney infections (pyelonephritis), who have limited or no alternative treatment options.
